ADI Foundation and Datrics Partner With NEAR on TravAI, an AI and Blockchain-Powered Travel Platform

December 5, 2025

NEAR AI Team

Today, NEAR Protocol, ADI Chain, and Datrics are announcing TravAI, a next-generation travel management platform that brings autonomous AI agents and verifiable blockchain settlement into a single enterprise-grade workflow. Built on NEAR Intents and integrated with ADI Chain’s regulated settlement layer, TravAI is a clear real-world demonstration that agentic commerce is moving from concept to production.

TravAI eliminates the fragmented systems that corporations rely on for booking, approvals, and payments. Instead of navigating vendors, policies, and multiple payment rails, a user simply states their travel intent—destination, timing, constraints—and an AI agent handles the entire process automatically. Search, selection, booking, approval, and settlement all occur through a unified, verifiable pipeline.

The Infrastructure Powering TravAI

TravAI uses NEAR Intents as its transaction and coordination layer, enabling AI agents to perform complex, multi-chain operations without burdening the user with wallet switching, token conversions, or settlement logic. Enterprises can pay with nearly any asset, while NEAR Intents converts and settles on ADI Chain for a fully auditable, compliance-ready record. 

Equally important, TravAI highlights how AI agents require scalable and verifiable infrastructure to transact securely at scale. NEAR’s sharded infrastructure ensures transactions around traveler data, budgets, and corporate policies can be processed at high volume while maintaining trust and transparency across the workflow.

Why TravAI Matters for Enterprise AI

TravAI is more than a travel tool. It is a reference architecture for autonomous enterprise operations. Any workflow involving procurement, logistics, financial routing, or multi-step approvals can now be orchestrated by AI agents using NEAR technology, from intent-based infrastructure for seamless cross-chain transactions to NEAR AI Cloud for private inference around sensitive workloads.  

The next era of enterprise automation will be private, verifiable, and agent-driven, and it’s already being built on NEAR. Interested in exploring how NEAR AI can power your enterprise? Reach out to our team of experts today: https://www.near.ai/contact
